configurations.name: web
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 24 >/dev/null && npm run dev

configurations.name: web-local
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 24 >/dev/null && AUTH_MODE=local npm run dev

configurations.name: web-oidc
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 24 >/dev/null && AUTH_MODE=oidc OIDC_ISSUER=http://127.0.0.1:9/ OIDC_CLIENT_ID=clockspan-dev OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET=dev APP_URL=http://localhost:5173 npm run dev

configurations.name: prod
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 24 >/dev/null && npm run build && PORT=8090 npm start
